title: Anime Wow
blurb: The anime 'wow' — a breathless, sparkly-eyed gasp of amazement that anime characters deploy at everything from sunsets to sandwiches. The meme usage is gloriously ironic: play it over the most mundane accomplishment imaginable. Someone parallel parks adequately? Anime wow. The vending machine gives correct change? Anime wow. Cheap awe, infinitely renewable.
origin: The classic wide-eyed anime gasp, memed as ironic amazement at nothing.
